description: A sample website for a local house painting company: before and after, services, reviews and a free-estimate request. A concept by Tava Valenti.

hero.alt: A freshly painted two-story craftsman house with sage siding and white trim
hero.h1: Fresh paint, *clean lines,* no mess left behind.
hero.sub: Interior and exterior painting, cabinets, decks and fences for homes across North County San Diego. Careful prep, and a crew that treats your home like theirs.

before_after.text: Faded, chalky stucco and peeling trim in Vista, washed, patched, primed and painted. Drag the line to compare.

services_head.text: We do the prep most painters skip: washing, scraping, patching and taping, so the finish lasts.

services.alt: A freshly painted white stucco house with charcoal trim
services.title: Exterior painting
services.text: Stucco, siding and trim, with power washing and crack repair before any paint goes on.

services.alt: A living room painted soft greige with white trim
services.title: Interior painting
services.text: Walls, ceilings and trim, with furniture covered and floors protected every day.

services.alt: Kitchen cabinets painted navy with brass pulls
services.title: Cabinet painting
services.text: A new-looking kitchen for a fraction of new cabinets, with a hard, wipeable finish.

services.alt: A backyard fence and deck stained a cedar tone
services.title: Decks & fences
services.text: Cleaning, sanding and staining that brings old wood back and protects it from the sun.

services.alt: A brush cutting a clean white line along door trim
services.title: Trim & doors
services.text: Crisp lines on baseboards, doors and windows, the details that make a room look finished.

services.alt: A painter rolling paint on a stucco wall from a ladder
services.title: Prep & stucco repair
services.text: Patching cracks, fixing wood rot and priming, so problems don't come back through the paint.

steps.text: No pressure and no surprise charges. You'll know the colors, the schedule and the price before we start.

items.title: Call or send photos
items.text: Tell us which rooms or walls. A few phone photos help us give you a quick ballpark.

items.title: Free estimate & colors
items.text: We look at the surfaces, help you pick colors, and send a written, fixed price within two days.

items.title: We paint and clean up
items.text: Furniture and floors covered every day. We walk through it with you at the end.

about.alt: A painter rolling a stucco wall from a ladder
about.h2: Family run, *on the job every day.*
about.text: Fairwind is a small, family-owned painting company in Vista. The owner does your estimate, picks colors with you and checks the work every day until it's done.

estimate.text: Send a few details and we'll call you back within one business day to set up a time.
